description: Tri-Vector is a three-member squad uniting diverse skills to chart new trajectories through open space data. Just as three vectors define position and momentum in three-dimensional space, each member brings a distinct strength to our mission—combining technical precision, creative problem-solving, and strategic vision to tackle complex aerospace and Earth science challenges.
summary: We all three designed a website through which we can teach children what to do before going to a Space Mission in a playful and knowledgeable way. Our website help to teach kids about the many difficulties astronauts have to face in space.
